items.reason: A lightweight niacinamide gel that gives a matte finish and suits skin that looks shiny by midday.
A gentle, non-stripping cleanser keeps the surface fresh without adding actives or dryness.
A mineral SPF 50 fluid gives daily sun protection and fits easily into a short morning routine.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, apply the mattifying gel, and finish with the mineral SPF in the morning. Keep it to these three steps for a couple of weeks so you can see how your skin's shine looks by lunchtime before adding anything else.
